g.text: ITEM 1: FLG-002 HOUSING MAIN TIE-BOLT (2X TOTAL)
NOTE: FLG-002 also passes through the two PLT-004 standoff tubes to clamp the platform deck.
ITEM 2: LH-006 PROTRUDING BRASS OIL TUBE (1X TOTAL)
ITEM 3: UH-004 INSULATED BRUSH CAP PLUG (2X TOTAL)
ITEM 5: PLT-004 MOUNT STANDOFF TUBE (2X TOTAL)
NOTE: FLG-002 housing bolts pass THROUGH these tubes; they set platform-deck standoff.
ITEM 6: SPN-005 SPINDLE SET SCREW (1X TOTAL)
NOTE: Locks armature lower journal (SHF-003) inside the basket drive spindle (SPN-002).
ITEM 7: SPN-006 BASKET RETENTION SPRING (1X TOTAL)
NOTE: 3-prong steel spring at the spindle impeller hub; basket secures against it.
ITEM 8: SPN-007 SPRING RETAINING SCREW (1X TOTAL)
NOTE: Brass slotted dome head screw; fastens SPN-006 to the spindle hub.
ITEM 9: PLT-005 GASKET DECK FASTENER (4X TOTAL)
NOTE: Original = Rivet. Restoration = stainless M4-0.7 x 10mm flat-head Phillips screw + hex nut.
NOTE: Restoration specifically reuses the original PLT-006 washers.
ITEM 10: PLT-006 GASKET DECK WASHER (4X TOTAL)
NOTE: Original washer. Retained for use with restoration M4 hardware.

svg.text: 1. SCOPE: Ancillary hardware schedule mapping structural fasteners, plugs, and spindle hardware.
2. TIE-BOLTS (FLG-002): Pass through stator yoke to clamp upper and lower housings.
3. OIL TUBE (LH-006): Brass tube pressed into lower casting; houses lubricating wick.
4. BRUSH CAPS (UH-004) / SET SCREWS (UH-005): Plugs and retainers for carbon motor brushes.
5. STANDOFFS (PLT-004): Flange bolts route inside these to structure the platform deck assembly.
6. SPINDLE HARDWARE: SPN-005 (set screw) + SPN-006 (3-prong spring) + SPN-007 (brass retention screw).
7. METROLOGY: Dimensions marked (EST.) or (SYN) pending direct bench confirmation.
8. DECK FASTENERS (PLT-005): Original rivets drilled out; replaced with M4 hardware.

REPRODUCTION DOCUMENT — Not an original L&R Mfg. Co. technical publication. Reverse-engineered from direct physical measurement of specimen S/N 13505. Curated by Hobbs R.E., 2026. For restoration reference only.
